_note: Lines for the first visits to the village shops (data/events/store_intro.json, smithy_intro.json): Sayo at the Yorozu Store (from line store), Gen at the Kurogane Smithy (from line smithy). Each part ends with next: end.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Welcome! Oh, a new face. You must be the one who took over the old farm up the road. I'm Sayo.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Yorozu means 'a bit of everything'. Seeds for the season, sweets, odds and ends. And I buy good crops, too.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: We're open from nine to five, every day but Sunday. Talk to me at the counter when you need something.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: The seeds change with the season, so look in again when summer comes!

lines.speaker: gen
lines.text: ...Hm. The new farmer. Tome said you'd come. I'm Gen. Mind the forge, it bites.

lines.speaker: gen
lines.text: Bring me a tool you trust, and some coin, and I'll make it better. Wider swings, harder hits.

lines.speaker: gen
lines.text: Good iron takes a few days. Leave it at the counter and come back for it. Open ten to four, shut on Wednesdays.

lines.speaker: gen
lines.text: ...That's all. Work your tools hard. They get to know your hands.
